segments.name: Real Estate Management Services
segments.description: Provides facility, property and project management and portfolio services to occupiers and owners of real estate worldwide.
segments.evidence: Our Real Estate Management Services business provides a broad suite of integrated services to occupiers of real estate, including facility and property management, project management, and portfolio and other services.

segments.name: Leasing Advisory
segments.description: Offers agency leasing, tenant representation and advisory and consulting services to property owners and occupiers globally.
segments.evidence: Leasing Advisory offers agency leasing and tenant representation, as well as advisory and consulting services.

segments.name: Capital Markets Services
segments.description: Provides investment sales, debt and equity advisory and value and risk advisory services to real estate investors.
segments.evidence: Through December 31, 2025, we managed and reported our operations as five business segments: Real Estate Management Services, Leasing Advisory, Capital Markets Services, Investment Management, and Software and Technology Solutions.

segments.name: Investment Management
segments.description: Invests for clients globally in private real estate assets and publicly traded real estate securities.
segments.evidence: Through LaSalle Investment Management (also referred to as "LaSalle" or our "Investment Management" segment), we invest for clients on a global basis in both private assets and publicly traded real estate securities.

segments.name: Software and Technology Solutions
segments.description: Provides software and technology products and services to real estate clients.
segments.evidence: Effective January 1, 2026, the Software and Technology Solutions segment will merge into Real Estate Management Services with results of operations reported as a subsegment within Real Estate Management Services.

revenueModel.text: Real estate owners, occupiers, investors and developers pay fees and cost reimbursements for property, facility, project, leasing and advisory services.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer our real estate services locally, regionally and globally to real estate owners, occupiers, investors and developers for a variety of property types

changes.text: In 2025 the investments historically reported within Software and Technology Solutions moved to All Other.
changes.evidence: Effective July 1, 2025, we report the balances and activity associated with the investments historically reported within Software and Technology Solutions in "All Other."

changes.text: In 2026 the Software and Technology Solutions segment merges into Real Estate Management Services as a subsegment.
changes.evidence: Effective January 1, 2026, the Software and Technology Solutions segment will merge into Real Estate Management Services with results of operations reported as a subsegment within Real Estate Management Services.
